title: International Tax Type Setup — sorting by Effective Date does not reorder the rows
requirementSource: NM-4026 — TestRail C107651: Effective Date sorts oldest first ascending, newest first descending
stepsToReproduce: Open Tax → International Tax Type Setup for office 1606 (/navigator/locations/1606/taxes/international-tax-type-setup) on e2e (UTC browser).
Open the Effective Date header menu and choose Sort ascending, then Sort descending.
expectedBehavior: Rows are ordered by Effective Date.
actualBehavior: Rows stay in Province order (Alberta … Yukon) for both directions; sorting by GOV Tax Type Name through the same menu works.

verificationLog.finding: Failed in the full run and the isolated rerun; the failure snapshot shows the grid still in Province order after the sort.
